title: Kiwidum Keto Comfort
description: A savory and dense Korean dish featuring kiwifruit, dumplings, and keto-friendly ingredients for a sick-day meal.

ingredients.name: Low-Carb Marinade (optional)
ingredients.notes: For dipping the dumplings if desired.

instructions: Prepare the pork dumplings by marinating them in a low-carb marinade for at least an hour. Drain and set aside.
Gently warm up the kiwifruit slices in the microwave until they're soft but not mushy, about 1 minute per side.
Warm up some olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the dumplings to cook them through, about 5 minutes per batch if using all at once.
Serve the warm dumplings and kiwifruit slices together for a refreshing and comforting meal.
